title: Denmark – Industrial machinery – C-Tech test facility for Aalborg University (Esbjerg)
description: The contracting authority is issuing this tender in relation to research activities carried out within the Carbon Transformation & Energy Control Hub (C TECH) project at AAU Energy. The project aims to establish a modular pilot and demonstration facility in Esbjerg for carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) and Power to X (PtX) technologies. The facility should consist of an integrated setup of four 20-foot containers housing electrolysis (hydrogen production), CO2 capture, methanol synthesis, and a supply container. The establishment of the facility is part of the project's overall objective to accelerate the development and demonstration of existing and emerging CCUS and Power to X technologies. In addition, the project contributes to competence development by supporting the education and training of future engineers and fostering collaboration with industry partners and public stakeholders in the region and beyond. title: Netherlands – Vehicles for the emergency services – Watertankwagens
description: De aanbestedende dienst is voornemens om een raamovereenkomst met één (1) opdrachtnemer te sluiten voor de levering van initieel acht (8) en optioneel twee (2) watertankwagens. De garantieperiode maakt integraal onderdeel uit van de opdracht en wordt altijd afgenomen. Het onderhoud na afloop van de garantieperiode kan optioneel worden afgenomen middels een service- en onderhoudsovereenkomst. Van de acht (8) initiële watertankwagens zijn zeven (7) watertankwagens bestemd voor Veiligheidsregio IJsselland en één (1) watertankwagen voor Veiligheidsregio Fryslân. Van deze initiële afname dienen uiterlijk eind Q2 2028 vijf (5) watertankwagens voor Veiligheidsregio IJsselland en één (1) watertankwagen voor Veiligheidsregio Fryslân te worden geleverd. De twee (2) resterende watertankwagens van de initiële bestelling zijn bestemd voor Veiligheidsregio IJsselland en hebben een voorziene leverdatum in 2029. De optie voor de levering van de twee (2) optionele watertankwagens in 2029 en het daarbij behorende optioneel af te nemen onderhoud is afhankelijk van de uitkomst van het bluswaterplan van de aanbestedende dienst. Daarnaast biedt de raamovereenkomst de mogelijkheid om gedurende de looptijd aanvullende watertankwagens af te nemen indien daar aanleiding toe bestaat, bijvoorbeeld als gevolg van total-loss of onherstelbare schade aan bestaande watertankwagens.

title: Denmark – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Udbud af udvikling af Den Veterinære Receptløsning
description: Indførelsen af “Lov om lægemidler, lov om apoteksvirksomhed og lov om dyrlæger” i 2006 skabte grundlag for at styrke de tekniske muligheder for receptudstedelse og udlevering af veterinære lægemidler til dyr i Danmark. Der har siden været bred opbakning til en fælles digital løsning for dyrlæger, apoteker, § 39 vet-forhandlere og myndigheder, senest fremhævet i Fødevare-Veterinæraftalen 2024-2027. I dag håndteres veterinære ordinationer fortsat i vidt omfang via papir, fax eller pdf. Det medfører manuelle arbejdsgange, øget risiko for fejl og mangelfuld dokumentation samt vanskeligere og mere ressourcekrævende myndighedskontrol. Formålet med udbuddet er derfor at Leverandøren skal udvikle Den Veterinære Receptløsning (DVR eller Løsningen), der skal forbedre sikkerheden og kvaliteten i hele processen fra udstedelse af recept til udlevering af lægemiddel. Løsningen skal give mulighed for at optimere arbejdsgange og skabe et ubrudt og beskyttet digitalt flow af receptdata og dermed at sikre både fortrolighed, integritet og sporbarhed til gavn for dyreejere, dyrlæger, apoteker og myndigheder. Hvert år udstedes der ca. 1,1 mio. recepter til dyr (produktionsdyr og hobbydyr). Danmark har i alt omkring 6.000 dyrlæger med autorisation, hvoraf ca. 2.650 er aktive dyrlæger fordelt på ca. 1.000 dyrlægepraksis. Alle autoriserede dyrlæger kan som udgangspunkt udskrive recepter. Lægemidler til dyr distribueres via landets apoteker samt særlige § 39-forhandlere. Lægemiddelstyrelsens liste over forhandlere af veterinære lægemidler til produktionsdyr omfatter aktuelt omkring 85 apoteker og et lille antal autoriserede virksomheder (pt. 4 § 39-forhandlere) med tilladelse og fagpersonale (farmaceuter og farmakonomer) til at sælge, udlevere og informere om medicin til produktionsdyr. Der findes ca. 45.000 landbrugsbedrifter med dyr, registreret i det Centrale Husdyrbrugsregister (CHR) hos Fødevarestyrelsen. Herudover har Danmark en stor population af hobbydyr og kæledyr. Det anslås, at der findes omkring 810.000 hunde og 730.000 katte i danske hjem. Hertil kommer cirka 177.000 heste, der primært holdes som hobby- og sportsdyr. Leverandøren skal udvikle den samlede Løsning, der skal bestå af DVR-løsningen og Stamdataløsningen. Udviklingsopgaven af DVR-løsningen består af tre hoveddele: 1. DVR-applikationen, som varetager den centrale forretningslogik, samt 2. DVR services, som udstiller de nødvendige services til brug for de eksterne anvendersystemer 3. DVR online (option), som udgør en webbrugergrænseflade for receptudstedelse Udviklingsopgaven af Stamdataløsningen omfatter tre hoveddele: 1. Stamdataindlæsere, som håndterer indlæsning af data fra stamdatakilder, 2. Stamdatadatabase, som opbevarer de konsoliderede stamdata, samt 3. Stamdata services, som udstiller stamdata til brug for DVR-løsningen og de eksterne anvendersystemer. Udbuddet omfatter tillige levering af de nødvendige services og integrationsmuligheder, der understøtter integration til relevante stamdatakilder samt eksterne anvendersystemers integration med DVR-løsningen, herunder dyrlægesystemer, § 39 vet-forhandlersystemer og apotekssystemer. De eksterne anvendersystemer er ikke en del af løsningen. Leverandøren skal endvidere levere en løsning, der understøtter sikkerhed og logning. Dette omfatter de sikkerheds- og logningsmekanismer, der er nødvendige for at beskytte receptdata og stamdata samt sikre sporbarhed i Løsningen. Udbuddet omfatter desuden vedligeholdelse og 2nd level support af Løsningen fra Overtagelsesdagen. Der skal endvidere leveres Hypercare i en begrænset periode efter idriftsættelsen. Vedligeholdelse og support skal ske i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten, herunder de fastsatte servicemål. Kontrakten indeholder desuden rammeaftalelignende elementer i form af bestillingsydelser og øvrige timebaserede ydelser, som vederlægges efter medgået tid på grundlag af de fastsatte timepriser. Timepriserne er knyttet til tre medarbejderkategorier med nærmere beskrevne kvalifikationer og erfaringsniveauer til rådighed for Kunden. Udbuddet gennemføres som et udbud med forhandling, jf. udbudslovens § 61 stk. 1, nr. a, idet ordregivers behov ikke kan imødekommes uden tilpasning af allerede tilgængelige løsninger. I henhold til Udbudslovens § 49, stk. 2 om opdeling i delkontrakter (opdel-eller-forklar-princippet) er det Lægemiddelstyrelsens vurdering, at Kontrakten ikke hverken it-strategisk, teknisk eller forretningsmæssigt er egnet til at opdele i særskilte delkontrakter.

title: Germany – Expert witness services – Schachtanlage Asse II: Sachverständiger der atomrechtlichen Aufsicht nach § 20 AtG: Begutachtung von Fragestellungen in Bezug auf die Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung
description: Gegenstand des Auftrags ist die sachverständige Unterstützung des BASE bei der atomrechtlichen Aufsicht über die Schachtanlage Asse II gemäß § 20 AtG im Bereich der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die fachliche Prüfung und Bewertung von Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung der Schachtanlage Asse II. Hierzu gehören insbesondere: - die Unterstützung bei atom- und strahlenschutzrechtlichen Verfahren zur Änderung der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung und des zugehörigen betrieblichen Regelwerks, - die fachliche Bewertung von Änderungen, insbesondere hinsichtlich ihrer Wesentlichkeit im Sinne des Atomrechts, - die Prüfung und Bewertung vorgelegter Unterlagen und Daten hinsichtlich Schlüssigkeit, Nachvollziehbarkeit und fachlicher Richtigkeit, - die Begleitung wiederkehrender Prüfungen an Anlagenteilen, Systemen und Komponenten der Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung einschließlich der Dichtheitsprüfung umschlossener Strahlenquellen, - die Erstellung von Gutachten, Prüfberichten, Stellungnahmen und Protokollen zu den jeweiligen Prüfergebnissen sowie - die Unterstützung der atomrechtlichen Aufsicht bei Fragestellungen, die eine Prüfung oder Begutachtung vor Ort erfordern. Die Strahlenschutzinstrumentierung umfasst insbesondere Einrichtungen zur Ortsdosis- und Ortsdosisleistungsüberwachung, zu Oberflächenkontaminationsmessungen, zur Personendosimetrie und Inkorporationsüberwachung sowie zur Raumluft-, Abluft- und Immissionsüberwachung. Zur Wahrnehmung der Aufgaben, insbesondere zur Begleitung wiederkehrender Prüfungen, sind während der Vertragslaufzeit regelmäßig Vor-Ort-Termine und Befahrungen der Schachtanlage Asse II erforderlich. Eine nähere Projektbeschreibung, in der das Beschaffungsvorhaben eingehend erläutert wird, ist in der Vergabeunterlage „Leistungsbeschreibung“ enthalten.

description: Gegenstand dieser Vergabe ist die Betriebsführung der Deponie Wiedenzhausen. Die im Jahr 1979 von der Regierung von Oberbayern genehmigte im Landkreis Dachau befindliche Deponie Wiedenzhausen befindet sich aktuell in der Stilllegungsphase. Ursprünglich wurden auf der Deponie Aluminiumschmelzschlacke und Aluminiumoxidstaub abgelagert. Nachdem die weitere Ablagerung von Schlacke unzulässig geworden war, erfolgte die Sanierung der Altbereiche sowie die nachträgliche Ausstattung bislang nicht abgedeckter Deponieabschnitte mit einer qualifizierten Oberflächenabdichtung. Infolge der Insolvenz der Betreibergesellschaft befindet sich die Deponie seit Anfang des Jahres 2022 in der Ersatzvornahme durch die Regierung von Oberbayern. Gegenstand der zu vergebenden Leistung ist die Wahrnehmung sämtlicher Aufgaben, die im Rahmen der (technischen) Betriebsführung einer Deponie während der Stilllegungs- und Nachsorgephase anfallen. Onder een Webinar verstaat de aanbestedende dienst een activiteit op het internet waaraan een online publiek kan deelnemen: een online live uitzending. Bij een Webinar is het mogelijk om vanaf één locatie een interactieve presentatie te geven voor een publiek dat kan variëren van enkele tot duizenden deelnemers. De deelnemers kunnen door middel van een (eigen) device (laptop, computer, tablet of mobiele telefoon) het Webinar volgen ongeacht waar ze zich bevinden. Om deel te kunnen nemen hoeven zij (in de meeste gevallen) alleen op een link te klikken om direct deel te nemen aan het Webinar. De omvang van de opdracht is geraamd op 200 Webinars voor vier (4) jaar, de totale duur van de raamovereenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. De maximale waarde van de opdracht is berekend over de maximale duur van de raamovereenkomst inclusief de opties tot verlenging en bedraagt € 1.400.000,- exclusief btw.

title: Vertical Launching System (VLS) Outer Boards and Structures
description: This advanced notice is in response to the sources sought notice originally posted under N6339426R0007 on 02 February 2026 and updated on 09 February 2026. Based on the results of the sources sought notice, the Government anticipates issuing solicitation N6339427R0003 as a full and open competition. The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division anticipates a contract requirement for the procurement of the Outer Board Assembly, Lower A-Side part number (P/N) 6539759-9, Outboard Assembly, Lower B-Side P/N 6539761-9, Lower Outboard Structure A-Side, P/N 5599357-39, and Structure Lower B-Side P/N 5599356-19 for the Vertical Launching System (VLS). These are Naval Sea Systems Command part numbers. The VLS structural assembly integrates the outer boards, lower boards, plenum, uptake assemblies, and internal supports into a single, rigid, shock-qualified launcher module. The primary North American Industry Classification System code for this procurement is 336414, with a Size Standard of 1300 employees. The anticipated period of performance is five years, consisting of a five-year ordering period. The Government anticipates awarding a Single Award Firm-Fixed-Price Indefinite-Delivery-Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract. The Request for Proposal (RFP) is anticipated to be issued on or about December 2026. Drawings will be provided via DoD SAFE to all Joint Certification Program-registered requestors once the RFP has been posted to Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment. All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation for consideration by the agency. Disclaimer: This presolicitation notice is for informational purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to solicit contractual offers or award contracts. The Government is not soliciting, and will not accept, proposals in response to this synopsis. If a competitive solicitation is issued in the future, it will be announced via SAM.gov and interested parties must comply with the solicitation announcement. The Government will not reimburse respondents costs associated with submitting questions or providing information in response to this notice. This is not a solicitation or a promise to issue a solicitation, and this information is subject to modification and does not bind the Government to award a contract.

title: Rammeavtale elektromateriell
description: Oppdragsgiver forvalter flere kirker, gravplasser og øvrige eiendommer, noe som medfører at oppdragsgiver har et løpende behov for elektromateriell til drift og vedlikehold. Oppdragsgiver skal inngå en rammeavtale med én leverandør, og formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre at Bergen kirkelige fellesråd får dekket sitt samlede behov for elektromateriell på en effektiv og hensiktsmessig måte. Ved større prosjekter vil oppdragsgiver forespørre leverandør om prosjektpriser, hvor også tilkjøring og levering vil være en viktig del av oppdraget.Oppdragsgiver har i dag en tilsvarende rammeavtale med Onninen som utløper januar 2027. Forventet oppstart på denne rammeavtalen er derfor januar 2027. Avtalen inngås for en periode på to (2) år fra signeringsdato. Oppdragsgiver har opsjon til å forlenge avtalen med ett (1) år av gangen, i inntil to (2) ganger. Maksimal samlet avtaleperiode er fire (4) år. Opsjoner utløses ved skriftlig beskjed av oppdragsgiver minimum tre (3) måneder før utløp. Avtalen opphører automatisk ved utløp av avtaleperioden. Dersom alle opsjoner benyttes er anskaffelsens forventede totalverdi kr. 10 000 000, med et årlig forventede uttak på kr. 2 5000 000. Maksimal kontraktsverdi er kr. 15 000 000. Summen er beregnet på historiske data.

title: Norway – Electrical materials – Framework agreement for electrical material
description: The contracting authority manages several churches, cemeteries and other properties, which means that the contracting authority has a continual need for electrical material for operation and maintenance. The contracting authority shall enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer and the objective of the procurement is to ensure that Bergen Church Council can meet its total need for electro material in an efficient and appropriate manner. The contracting authority will ask the tenderer for major projects on project prices, where delivery and delivery will also be an important part of the assignment. The contracting authority currently has an equivalent framework agreement with Onninen that expires in January 2027. The expected start-up of this framework agreement is therefore January 2027. The contract will be signed for a period of two (2) years from when the contract is signed. The contracting authority has the option to extend the contract for one (1) year at a time, for up to two (2) times. The total maximum agreement period is four (4) years. The options will be taken up by written notification by the contracting authority at least three (3) months before the expiry date. The contract will automatically expire at the end of the agreement period. If all options are utilised, the procurement ́s expected total value is NOK 100,000,000 excluding VAT. 10,000,000, with an annual expected call-off of NOK 10,000,000. 2 5000 000. title: Ireland – Repair and maintenance services of mechanical building installations – fabrication and Maintenance
description: Dublin Bus is looking to establish a fabrication and maintenance framework with appropriate Contractors to carry out repair and maintenance at each of its facilities which consists of All locations throughout Dublin City and County. Dublin Bus wishes to establish a contract, which will provide ongoing basic fabrication and maintenance, repair and small new-works at all Dublin Bus locations There will be 2 lots under this tender. Lot 1 will account for most of the work; mechanical maintenance (fabrication) works of all facilities and small new installations (less than €15,000 ex VAT). This will be a direct-award contract to the successful contractor. Lot 1 contract value is estimated to be ca. €280k per annum excluding VAT. Lot 2 will be for larger new installation (greater than €15,000 ex VAT) additional works beyond the scope of Lot 1. It is intended to form a framework and run mini competitions for works in this category. No previous call-offs were made under this Lot however; it is included in the new framework to accommodate future requirements falling within this scope. These sums are aligned with ASC funding currently. In order to provide for potential future expanded requirements in this area, the overall framework value over the maximum duration will be advertised at a value of €1.3M to provide adequate headroom in the contract award mechanism should additional projects or major unforeseen repair work arise. This value will be conditional on budget availability and does not represent a commitment to spend. The initial contract will be for three years with an option to extend for a further 12 months

title: Fully Managed Renal Dialysis Satellite Unit in Crawley Area
description: South West London Procurement Partnership (SWLPP), on behalf of Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust (ESTH) (the "Authority") invites tenders from experienced and qualified organizations for the provision of a fully managed renal satellite dialysis satellite unit located in the Crawley area, providing all the facilities, equipment, consumables and renal nursing services required to deliver a fully managed renal dialysis satellite unit. The objective of this competitive tender exercise is to select a single provider capable of delivering high-quality, cost-effective solutions in accordance with the specifications detailed in the Tender Pack. A detailed Specification of Requirements is included in the Tender Documentation. Please note, the current Crawley renal dialysis satellite unit is a joint venture between Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust (ESTH) and University Hospitals Sussex NHS Foundation Trust (UHSx). Patients from both Trusts currently receive treatment at the Crawley unit. At the time of the pre-market engagement, both Trusts fully intended reprocuring the Crawley unit jointly. However, it has since been agreed that each Trust will independently procure a solution for their own cohort of patients from the Crawley area. This tender will only include activity numbers for patients under the treatment of Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust (ESTH). Current and estimated numbers will be included in the Tender Documentation. Additional information: To express interest and participate in the tender, please register and apply via Atamis e-sourcing portal https://health-family.force.com/s/Welcome. Should Tenderers have any queries, or having problems using the portal, they should contact Helpdesk at: Phone: 0800 9956035 E-mail: support-health@atamis.co.uk

description: The Office of the Secretary to the Governor General (OSGG) Information Technology Directorate is responsible for all information technology systems, including their deployment, maintenance and support. These systems include, but are not limited to, servers, desktops, applications, networks, messaging, virtualization, security, storage, authentication services, Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) and cloud computing/networking. While the OSGG IT Directorate provides day-to-day operational support for the IT environment, certain requirements involving high-priority incidents, complex infrastructure issues, specialized technical expertise, or time-limited initiatives exceed the capacity or expertise available internally. The OSGG requires access to a flexible source of specialized technical expertise, on an as-requested basis through Task Authorizations, to support the resolution of priority incidents, infrastructure and cloud initiatives, system optimization activities, technical planning, architecture services, documentation, and knowledge transfer requirements. Canada may require a team of up to five (5) resources under the following TBIPS resource categories: Two (2) I.9 System Administrator (Level 3) resources; and Three (3) I.10 Technical Architect (Level 3) resources. Services may involve network, infrastructure, cloud, storage, security and related technologies within the OSGG environment and will be performed through Task Authorizations issued on an as-and-when-requested basis.

title: Mediator Consultant - Manitoba for the Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS)
description: The Programs Branch (PB) of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) has requirements on an "as and when requested" basis for professional resources with expertise and skillsets for the delivery of financial counselling and mediation services. This requirement is to establish a Task Authorization Contract with a qualified Contractor's for services in Manitoba. It is intended to result in the award of 4 (four) contracts for 5 (five) years. The Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS) offers free financial counselling and mediation services to farmers who are having difficulties meeting their financial obligations. It is a voluntary, private and confidential service that brings farmers and their creditors together with a Mediator in a neutral forum to reach a mutually acceptable solution. The FDMS Administrator will assign a Financial Consultant and a Mediator to work with the farmer through the mediation process. Confidentiality is extremely important to the quality and effectiveness of the service. Information obtained from the farmer and their creditor(s) is used for the sole purpose of mediation and is shared only among the parties involved in the mediation process. The Mediator will facilitate communication between the farmer and their creditor(s), guide them through the mediation process, and remain neutral throughout. The Mediator will work collaboratively with the Financial Consultant to understand the context of the file, including the recovery plan developed by the farmer and the Financial Consultant. The Mediator will lead the mediation meeting and work with the parties toward a mutually acceptable solution. When the farmer and their creditor(s) reach an agreement, the Mediator will prepare the written arrangement and obtain the signatures of all participants

description: Notice to suppliers: This solicitation of offers is subject to the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement. description: Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. Ensure you are fully registered in CanadaBuys/SAP Ariba! All deliverables to Ottawa, ON must be delivered within ten weeks of contract award. Interested suppliers must meet the mandatory requirements detailed in the Statement of Requirement. The period of the contract is from the date of award to one year after the date of acceptance inclusive. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada.

description: PWGSC, on behalf of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada’s Research and Development Centre, is issuing this bid solicitation for the procurement of contractor services to carry out an intrusion alarm system upgrade project.
